reason: The core holds; three wording fixes are needed. (1) GRANDFATHER IS HONEST, NOT POST-HOC. Rule v2 (CONTEXT 07:43Z 28 Sep, R24-A3 (3)) applies to 'every dummy logged from now on', and its own text cites 'exp75 took 2,288 s' as evidence of run-to-run noise. exp75's dummy was logged at 17:21Z on 27 Sep. Under v2 it would in fact need a re-run: the ratio is 1.49 against the #37 dummy (1,535 s) and 1.34 against exp79a (1,712 s), both over 1.15. So the exemption has to be written out, and it holds. (2) A RE-DUMMY WOULD TELL US NOTHING NEW. The stage times from the re-parsed _dl logs (round21 r21rk-8) are, for DC / lowref / divins / CI / end: exp75 101/875/1286/1829/2288 s and exp79a 50/432/791/1258/1712 s. The CI stage took 459 s against 454 s. All of the excess comes before CI, on a slow dummy machine. A re-dummy only samples a new dummy machine and says nothing about the hidden-run machine. The output is already verified and deterministic (R25P-1: topology equals the #37 dummy, coordinates equal the exp79a dummy, sha12 d6d9d808303f). (3) RUNTIME IS SAFE, BUT 'BOUNDED' IS TOO STRONG. From the ledger, #37 took L (7.36, 7.54] h, exp70g (7.49, 7.67] h, and exp79a (9.27, 9.45] h, so CI added dL ~1.6-1.96 h. That predicts ~9.0-9.5 h for exp75. This is an estimate, not a strict bound: the hidden latency of the safetail family spans 6.87-7.81 h, which puts the worst case near 10 h. That is still under the 10.75 h ADMIT limit and the 12 h limit. CI runs after insertion, so the 8 h DIVINS deadline carries the same margin as #37. The 10.5 h CI deadline and the 9.5 h REPAIR deadline are fail-soft: a truncated CI falls back to #37 rows, which display about 0.954 and lead to 'keep #37', a safe outcome. (4) 'Clean test of CI on #37' overstates it. exp75's coordinates equal exp79a's, so its read is not an independent CI confirmation (R25P-5). (5) The line must also take exp75 off the 00:00Z R21-A3 (e) NO-GO list ('superseded, not unsafe'). Its new role is the private hedge (10:16Z), and the user approved the '3 night + 2 morning' schedule at 10:19Z. exp75 goes before 02:00Z, so the pending question about CI files in the morning does not apply. This duplicates R25P-8 from the same round. It is bookkeeping with no LB value of its own. The rules R1-R10 and R8 COVERAGE are respected: exp75 is named in the 00:00Z R8 coverage line.
